item: the custody export is a POST and the custody reads make no key or log
summary: POST /api/custody/export (it signs its head, so the first one makes the key). GET /settings, /{item_id} and /verify open only what exists: HybridSigner(create=False) and CustodyLog(create=False) never mint a key, make the keys folder, create custody_log.db or re-wrap a key file; settings says keys_created false and the Custody tab shows keys: none yet (x12). Walk floors 460/457.
